items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Well, we played at the Dreamland for them. You see, after we left the Cadillac, we went down and played for Spikes. Spike Brothers.

ctx.x: At that very time. What do you know about that? The Spikes Brothers, did you meet them? Spike Brothers, yeah.

Red Spikes, yeah. Johnny Spikes, yeah. Well, we played at the Dreamland for them. You see, after we left the Cadillac, we went down and played for Spikes. Spike Brothers. And they raided that John and police beat Johnny Spikes, so it was terrible. He was a tenor man. Beat himself in terrible. I never forget that. Yeah? Yes, indeed. What were they raided for?
Prohibition then? Yeah, it was Prohibition.
